conflict: none — did not build, stage, or assemble
choice_reason: A answers the stated job directly: the 35-member Team price ($420/month, $4,200/year on toggle) leads the page with an explicit fit rationale, and every commitment fact is covered, including the seat-change caveat with an honest 'no proration policy supplied' warning. B is also arithmetic-free via its prefilled 35-seat calculator, but it omits the supplied seat-change/proration fact entirely, places its fit guidance below a long comparison table, and renders no content at all without JavaScript. Within the 3-minute budget, A gets the ops lead to a defensible decision with less scanning and more complete commitment terms.
suspected_unblinding: No treatment identifiable. A's markup carries data-el/data-zone annotations (E1, E8, Zone A/B) and B's app.js has a guard comment about not inventing customers/metrics/policies — both suggest structured, rules-driven processes, but neither reveals which team or condition produced it.

findings.label: B
findings.description: Omits the supplied fact that seats may change during the billing period with no proration policy supplied, leaving the commitment picture incomplete for a team deciding on monthly vs annual spend.
findings.evidence: B/desktop.png full page shows no seat-change or proration content; grep for 'proration'/'seats' across B/source/app.js and B/source/pricing/index.html returns nothing, while A/source/index.html:153 carries the fact.

findings.label: B
findings.description: The entire page is client-rendered into an empty <main id="app"> shell, so no pricing content exists without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: B/source/pricing/index.html contains only the empty main element and a module script; all markup is template strings in B/source/app.js.

findings.label: B
findings.description: At 390 px the plan-differences table is cut off mid-column (Team truncated, Enterprise off-screen) with no visible scroll affordance, though the wrapper does scroll horizontally.
findings.evidence: B/evidence/state-03-390px-viewport.png shows clipped 'Monthly, or ann…' / '14 days, no cre…' cells; B/source/styles.css:286-287 (.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto }) confirms scroll containment.

findings.evidence: A/desktop.png: the Enterprise strip and decision block mention talking to sales but the only actionable control on the page is the Start Team trial form.

findings.label: B
findings.description: The fit recommendation — the decision-critical content — sits below a 15-row comparison table, and the 'Which plan fits?' section is a plain paragraph beside a large empty column, weakening hierarchy within the 3-minute budget.
findings.evidence: B/desktop.png: 'Which plan fits?' appears near the bottom, visually undifferentiated, with unused right-column whitespace.

findings.label: A
findings.description: The 'PRICING' nav label is small, low-contrast muted text on the tan background; the visible page also starts at h2 since the h1 is screen-reader-only via inline off-screen styling.
findings.evidence: A/desktop.png top-right nav; A/source/index.html:18 inline-styled sr-only h1.

score_notes.A_D4: Single clear trial CTA with validated form, but no actionable contact-sales affordance despite the brief naming it a valid next action.
score_notes.A_D7: Evidence-backed: radiogroup with ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down + Home/End and roving focus (source/app.js:54-77), visible focus ring reproduced in state-01 screenshot, skip link, :focus-visible outline, prefers-reduced-motion block (styles.css:554), labeled input with role=alert error and aria-invalid toggling.
score_notes.B_D2: Complete conventional IA, but the decision aid (fit guidance) is sequenced after the full table, and honest-but-noisy 'Not specified' rows (e.g. handoff template on Team) add uncertainty the layout never resolves.
score_notes.B_D5: All pricing arithmetic and trial/cancellation terms present and correct; the supplied seat-change/no-proration fact is missing (S2 finding).
score_notes.B_D6: Good state work (role=alert error, role=status success, live-region price updates, input clamped 1-100) but zero no-JS resilience from the empty shell.
score_notes.B_D7: Evidence-backed: role=switch with aria-checked and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight handling (app.js:355-365), focus ring reproduced in state-01 screenshot, table caption + th scope=col/row, labeled number input, aria-live calculator result; no prefers-reduced-motion rule found.
score_notes.B_D9: Layout stacks correctly at 390 px and the table scrolls in its own container, but clipped columns with no scroll hint add friction on the primary comparison content.

evidence_viewed: desktop, mobile/390px states, interaction screenshots (billing toggle annual, keyboard focus, validation error), sanitized source for both builds
